caveats: VPR process after identical input pre-read; pack/place excluded and fixed; RRG XML load, lookahead, routing, native FULL and STA included. Independent original readback reported separately in workflow. Pipeline-study variants all serialize a wire map inside process timing; every map is checked against original serial bytes, at every core count.
Four physical cores [60,61,62,63], freed by completed MultiQueue pilot. Other studies on disjoint core pools may overlap; shared memory/host. No exclusivity claimed.

Three fixed-seed paired repetitions for the five non-GEMM circuits, same four physical cores; timings include symmetric map serialization. Generalization beyond the six existing circuits remains limited.
Build-cache improvements are not routing-kernel acceleration; cache reuse is provided equally.
Failed routes are excluded from speedup ratios and remain part of the robustness result.
